title: The Globe and Mail (Harvey Schachter) — 'Without proper safeguards, entrepreneurs can lose control of the dream'
summary: Harvey Schachter — the long-running management columnist at Canada's national newspaper — walks readers through Incorruptible's Graveyard of Good Intentions (Sears, Cadbury, Filene's) and lands on Ries's redefinition of profit as 'the maximation of human flourishing.'
blockquote: But when the rubber hits the road – or, more accurately, the company meets the financial world of venture capitalists, investment bankers and shareholders – it falls apart.
blockquote_source: Harvey Schachter, The Globe and Mail
attribution_title: Management columnist, The Globe and Mail
